calibration_honest_note: Each model carries calibration_honest: the nested-split honest map (isotonic fit on 2026-07-01..2026-08-31 only, graded on untouched Sep games). The shipped `calibration` map was fit on the full tail and graded on the same tail (in-sample). The app toggle switches between them; default is the shipped map.
live_models_role_gold_note: Variant A (reports/live_role_gold.md): role golds replace total gold. Feed-only -- OCR games keep the baseline live_models (OCR has team gold only). CONDITIONAL SHIP: shadow-test on live Swiss games before letting variant A drive Kelly fractions; if the shadow test comes back <= 0, revert to baseline.
roster_formula: rating = snapshot_elo + delta_2026; delta_2026 = A - U; A = 1500 + 0.6*(1-0.5*t)*((1-t)*E_prev + t*incoming - 1500); U = 1500 + 0.6*(E_prev - 1500); t = 2025->2026 starter turnover; incoming = mean prior-year Elo of incoming starters' old teams (1500 for rookies). See reports/roster_strength.md.
calibration_note: 2026 holdout (fit_end <= date < cal_end), full draft model, pure-JSON recomputation. Backtest figures below are indicative: those backtests refit the model on pre-event data and do not use this artifact.

worlds_2025.note: out-of-sample: model fit only on games before the event's first game; offsets fit only on cross-region games before the event

msi_2026.note: out-of-sample: model fit only on games before the event's first game; offsets fit only on cross-region games before the event

confidence_tiers.rule: margin = |p_calibrated - 0.5|; bin = calibration bin containing p_calibrated
confidence_tiers.note: Tier reflects discrimination (margin) plus calibration evidence (bin sample size). Show the bin's observed accuracy as the honest confidence note, e.g. 'model was right 78% of the time in this range (n=312)'.

region_offsets.note: The exported models were TRAINED on elo_diff_adj, not elo_diff. Before scoring, the app must compute elo_diff_adj = elo_diff + off[region_blue] - off[region_red] using each team's region below (teams[].region) and this table; unknown region -> offset 0. Offsets are constant (no decay) and refit from cross-region games on every refresh -- see reports/region_strength_analysis.md.

metrics.holdout_ece_note: In-sample: the isotonic map was fit on this same holdout, so ECE~0 reflects fit quality, not out-of-sample calibration. Treat per-bin observed accuracies as indicative.
